title: Oh yes, juuuuuicy.
slide_intent: Carry an appetizing image into a shopping journey. A visitor should be able to move from attraction to choosing an item without losing the visual connection.
strategic_value: Instacart can use citrus imagery to tie a campaign message to store browsing and product selection.
demonstration: Three tall rounded screens share a citrus crop. It fills the left screen behind a headline, becomes a promotional header above shopping categories in the middle and tops a product listing at right.
practical_value: Determine when the photograph should dominate and when to reduce it to a header so shopping controls and item details take priority.

content_islands.name: Campaign screen
content_islands.spec: Center three equally tall panels on dark green. Fill the first with slices of citrus and place the white sensory headline over the crop.

content_islands.name: Browse screen
content_islands.spec: Use a shallow citrus header above the promotional action, categories and food cards. Align successive content rows beneath it.

content_islands.name: Store screen
content_islands.spec: Retain the citrus header and give the remaining area to store identity and item thumbnails with details.
